text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding e2e got a bunch of 429s when we ramped the SDK init pipeline to 30 concurrent workers. Steps: spawn 30 clients each calling /v1/embed/init.
lee: Can you paste logs? What rate limit headers did you get?
maria: Logs at the time:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 20
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 12
```
kavi: Oof. Looks like SDK default concurrency + aggressive prefetching. Which SDK/version and sampleapp config?
maria: js-sdk v0.9.2-alpha (onboarding sampleapp). We set `clientConcurrency=30` and `pagePrefetch=4` — trying to speed up cold-start batch ingest.
oliver: We saw a variant of this: token-refresh retries + no jitter stomped the quota. Any retries in the logs?
maria: Yes — saw 3x immediate retries. Snippet: `retryPolicy: {retries: 3, backoff: 1000}` — no jitter.
lee: We should update the sampleapp defaults to avoid slamming quotas. Proposal: default `clientConcurrency=8` for onboarding + exponential backoff with jitter for retries.
kavi: Agreed. Quick patch suggestion for sampleapp config:

```
clientConcurrency: 8
retryPolicy: {retries: 4, backoff: 'exponential', jitter: true}
prefetchPages: 1
```
Also add `X-Client-Id` header to group per-customer quota accounting.
maria: Would that slow perf for heavy customers during onboarding?
oliver: We can implement a progressive ramp: start 4 workers, ramp to 8 over 30s, and expose an env override for power users.
sre-bot: Incident detected: onboarding-onboarder-prod saw quota spillover at 2026-03-20T14:02:21Z — auto-throttle engaged.
lee: Can someone add a short devex doc note and a sampleapp PR? I'll file an issue if not.
maria: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/pull/432 — updates defaults and adds telemetry for rate headers. PTAL @lee @kavi
kavi: LGTM. I'll add an `exponentialJitter` helper to the SDK and a quickstart note about client-side limiters + ramping.
oliver: :thumbsup: Also add a tiny integration test that simulates a concurrent init ramp and asserts we never exceed 20 rps against a mocked quota.
maria: :party: Thanks everyone. Leaving the detailed logs in #eng-sre in case we need retention or to correlate with infra traces
